about: Smiths Falls is a town in Lanark County, Ontario, on the Rideau Canal at the junction of historic rail lines between Ottawa and Kingston. Combined locks, a canal-side downtown, and railway heritage define this Rideau service town. About 9,000 people live in Smiths Falls.
seoSummary: Lanark County town on the Rideau Canal—combined locks, railway heritage, and canal-side downtown.
